THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5
I, John Anthony Emmanuel Amarathunga, Minister of Lands hereby
declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition
Act, that the lands described below is needed for a public purpose and
will be acquired under the provisions of that Act.
An allotment of land in total extent of about 0.7082 Hectare depicted
in the Advance Tracing No. R/WLG/2014/961 dated 13th July 2015
prepared by the Ratnapura District Senior Superintendents of Survey
situated at Gangodagama village (C.M. 620142) Kadawatha Meda
korale minor Division, Weligepola Divisional Secretary’s Division of
Rathnapura District and Sabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot ‘A’ – Welkeptiyawewatta, Godaparaghahena – Extent:
0.7082 Hectare

Meegasdeniya; East: Welkeptiyawewatta claimed by E. M. Aruna
Dharmarathna and others; South: The Road; West: The Land Reserve
for the Road, Welkeptiyawewatta claimed by Land ReclamationCommission.
